title: Dude Amaker and piano in the district
summary: The interviewer asks about pianist Frank 'Dude' Amaker, who worked in the district.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Reminds me of... Did you know this fellow they call Dude? His real name is Frank Amaker. Dude? He lives at 520 Burgundy now.
Oh yeah, he played piano. Played piano.
Did he work around with him? No, he worked in the district, yeah. He worked at Pete Lawlinson, all the places now. Red Light District.

As a solo or with bass? Yeah, I mean it's... Why didn't he want to play something like Steve Lewis? You know what I mean? He didn't know that type of playing. He was pretty good. Pretty good player at that time. I don't know how he used to do it because I haven't waited many years, you know. But that Olympia band was a good band for the captain. I can't recall the bass, bro.
